goals: Verify the correct encryption and decryption of WIF keys using bip38 and passphrases.
Verify the re-encryption of an existing encrypted value with a new passphrase by sequentially decrypting and encrypting it.
activities: Mock wif.decode to return a predefined private key object
Mock bip38.encrypt to return a predefined encrypted key
Execute encryption.encrypt with a target value and passphrase
Assert that wif.decode was called with the target value
Assert that bip38.encrypt was called with the decoded private key, passphrase, and specific parameters
Assert that the returned encrypted value matches the mocked encrypted key
Mock bip38.decrypt to return a predefined private key object
Mock wif.encode to return a predefined decrypted value
Execute encryption.decrypt with an encrypted value and passphrase
Assert that bip38.decrypt was called with the encrypted value, passphrase, and specific parameters
Assert that wif.encode was called with the decrypted private key and compression flag
Assert that the returned decrypted value matches the mocked decrypted value
Spy on and mock encryption.encrypt to return a new encrypted value
Spy on and mock encryption.decrypt to return a decrypted value
Execute encryption.reEncrypt with an encrypted value, current passphrase, and new passphrase
Assert that encryption.decrypt was called with the original encrypted value and current passphrase
Assert that encryption.encrypt was called with the decrypted value and new passphrase
Assert that the returned value matches the new mocked encrypted value
Clear the mock states for the encrypt and decrypt spies
